readerCopy.headline: Meaning comes more easily right now.
readerCopy.body:
Writing, art, prayer, study, or quiet reflection may feel richer than usual. An idea can connect to something larger without you having to force the meaning out of it. You may also feel more generous toward a person or situation that used to seem much harder to understand.

Jupiter trine Neptune can make inspiration feel like enough. Use the open feeling to make something, study something, or give the insight a place in ordinary life. A beautiful hour can pass. A practice, page, or decision can keep working after it does.
doNotAssume: Do not assume spiritual certainty, artistic success, psychic phenomena, or permanent clarity.
